snippet.title: Teardown - Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Why is it so satisfying to break stuff? Owen Wilson ponders the existential nuance of destruction in Teardown - out now on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5! https://teardowngame.com/

Build it up, break it down, pull off a brilliant heist, or create a masterpiece. Whatever way you decide to spend your time in Teardown, the ultimate goal is to have fun.
